text:
Mara: Quick sync — need final narrative + visuals for the latency vs cost story. Webinar next Wed. Who can own the three-panel visual and the inbound routing CTA mapping?

Dan: I can mocked up a layout today. Thinking panels: 1) tail-latency distribution (CDF heatmap), 2) per-endpoint tokens-to-cost waterfall, 3) throughput vs dollars scatter with recommended knobs.

Lee: Love that. For panel 1 let's call out 95/99p and show how prefix caching shifts curves. Quick headline: "Cut tail latency without blowing spend." :zap:

Sharon: Messaging angle: enterprise cares about predictability and SLOs, startups care about cost per query. We should have two CTA paths on the registration form that tag leads: "Predictable SLA" vs "Lower token spend".

Mara: perfect — Lee + Dan, pair on the viz. Sharon can write two microcopy variants for the chart callouts. I'll route final to design for polish.

Dan: putting a tiny routing table here, will wire into inbound:
```
if lead.tags contains "enterprise": assign -> sales-enterprise
else if lead.cta == "Lower token spend": assign -> growth-smb
else assign -> product-led
```

Lee: I'll export variants (heatmap + scatter + waterfall) as SVG + PNG. Which data slices do we emphasize? Prod keys: chat short (32 tok), chat long (512 tok), embed (768 tok).

Sharon: writeups: 1-sentence hook, 3 bullets (what, why it matters, how Redwood helps), and a 15s demo transcript. I'll draft and post here.

launch-bot: Webinar page published: https://redwood.ai/webinar/latency-cost. Registration live. :tada:

Mara: Nice. Timeline: visuals + copy by end of day tomorrow, design polish Tues, dry run Wed morning, webinar Wed afternoon. Flagging legal for any compliance claims immediately.

Dan: will post first draft visuals in #marketing-design later today.

Sharon: first microcopy batch coming in 2 hours.

Lee: exporting now. cc @Mara

Mara: thanks all — keep thread tight, prefer small iterative uploads over big dumps. :thumbsup:
